title: TheJls Market Brief copy schema
description: Copy overlay for a published briefing. Cards are rendered as static HTML. Optional Marshall-approved photos are dropped in via image { url, credit } — never scraped, stocked, or generated.

id.description: Matches data-story-id on the HTML card

headline.description: Shipped headline, for Marshall lookup only

image.description: Render a visible thumbnail only when url and credit or caption are both present. Omit this object when Marshall did not ship a source photo.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL or page-relative path to the source photo

credit.description: Source name as shipped, shown in small type next to the thumbnail

caption.description: Optional caption; used for img alt when present
